parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Describe the movement you want the character to perform: for example, "walks forward, then jumps and waves."

parameters.name: characterModel
parameters.description: Optionally upload a 3D character mesh (FBX, GLB, or OBJ) to auto-rig and animate. Takes precedence over a reference image.

parameters.name: characterFile
parameters.description: Optionally upload a reference image of your character. Cartwheel generates and prepares it so the motion can be applied.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long the animation lasts, in seconds.

parameters.name: cfgScale
parameters.description: How closely the result follows your prompt. Higher values stick to your description more strictly; lower values give the model more creative freedom.

parameters.name: outputFormat
parameters.description: The file type you get back. Choose the one that matches your software: for example, GLB for general 3D use, or an FBX option for Blender, Maya, Unreal, or Roblox.

parameters.name: frameRate
parameters.description: How many frames play per second. Higher values look smoother; 24 is standard for film, 30 or 60 for games.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: Which direction the character is set to face. Match this to your 3D software's setup if the motion comes in turned the wrong way.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Which direction counts as "up" for the character. Match this to your 3D software if the motion comes in oriented incorrectly.

parameters.name: frameStepSize
parameters.description: Controls how often a frame is recorded. Higher values produce fewer frames and a lighter file, with slightly less smooth motion.

parameters.name: moveInPlace
parameters.description: Keeps the character animating on the spot instead of traveling across the scene: useful for game engines where movement is handled separately.

parameters.name: ikFeet
parameters.description: Use inverse kinematics for the feet. Applies only to Maya exports (FBX Maya, MA, MB).

parameters.name: ikHands
parameters.description: Use inverse kinematics for the hands. Applies only to Maya exports (FBX Maya, MA, MB).

parameters.name: faceExpression
parameters.description: An optional facial expression to apply throughout the animation, such as Happy, Angry, or Surprised.

parameters.name: handPose
parameters.description: The hand pose to apply on the character.

parameters.name: keyframeCleaning
parameters.description: Tidies up the animation data. Reduce and Simplify trim extra detail to make the file lighter and easier to edit by hand.

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Makes the animation repeat seamlessly, so the end flows back into the start without a visible jump.

parameters.name: skinHex
parameters.description: An optional color for the character's skin, given as a hex code (for example, #BF916D).
